BiblicalUsage: Alabaster, or white marble, is what David prepared for the house of God: gold for things of gold, silver for silver, brass for brass, iron for iron, and marble in abundance. One verse names it, among the materials of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the marble counts because David counted it, for he prepared with all his might, and I hold that giving God our best materials is part of giving Him our best selves.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
